description: Promo graphic for HUGE 10" calzones showing a sliced calzone with marinara and lists of meat and veggie topping choices.
Garlic cheese bread promo showing Original, Pepperoni, and Bacon varieties on serving trays.
New bone-in chicken wings promo with a plate of saucy wings and a cup of dipping sauce on a patriotic background.
Peanut butter dessert pizzas menu showing a bacon dessert pizza, peanut butter base, and Reese's Pieces topping with prices.
Menu board listing entree items (burgers, hot dogs, corn dogs) and side items (fries, nachos, mozzarella sticks) with prices, plus a basket of waffle fries.
Mega Pepperoni Pizza promo, a double-decker pizza with 2 crusts, 2 layers of cheese, and 4 layers of pepperoni.
New mozzarella sticks promo with a basket of breaded cheese sticks and marinara on a patriotic blue star background.
Nacho Bacon Cheesebread promo showing a round cut cheesebread loaded with nacho cheese and crispy bacon.
Bacon Nacho Pretzel Bites promo, pretzel bites topped with nacho cheese and bacon, with an 'Add Jalapenos' callout.
Specialty and premium specialty pizzas menu board with small/large prices and a photo of a topped pizza.
Maple waffle breakfast sandwiches promo showing bacon-egg-cheese and sausage-egg-cheese waffle sandwiches.
Create Your Own Pizza menu board with pricing, topping lists, and calzone/breadstick options beside a pepperoni pizza.
Mini Donuts promo showing fresh mini donuts with Apple Cider, Salted Caramel, and Cinnamon & Sugar flavors.
Fresh Salads promo featuring a Garden Salad and a Grilled Chicken Garden Salad, with a side salads note.
Birthday party package flyer detailing pricing, inclusions, and booking info for All Star Bowl and Beech Grove Bowl.
Photo of a birthday party scene in a bowling alley with balloons, kids, and a mother hugging her son.
Cropped birthday party photo of a mother in an orange top hugging her young son amid party balloons in the bowling alley.
Primary All Star Bowl 3DS brand logo: a red-white-and-blue shield with crossed bowling pins and a ball.
Upscaled colorful Beech Grove Bowl logo with 'Open 24 Hours' banner, music notes, and a bowling ball striking pins (filename says 'birthday' but content is the Beech Grove Bowl brand mark).
Smaller version of the Beech Grove Bowl logo with music notes and bowling pins (filename says 'birthday' but content is the Beech Grove Bowl brand mark).
Four-pose sheet of a cartoon bowling-pin mascot character (smiling/waving) on a transparent background; a brand mascot, not food.
Single upscaled cartoon bowling-pin mascot smiling and waving on a transparent background; a brand mascot, not food.
Bowlers' Appreciation Club (BAC) informational sheet with membership rates table and membership rules.
Hours of Operation sign listing daily open hours under the All Star Bowl logo.
Photo of young children bowling in the alley, used for youth bowling program promotion.
Wooden ball rack holding a row of colorful house bowling balls with the lanes and pins visible in the background.
Side view of 'The Alley Lounge' bar interior with a graffiti-style mural, taps, liquor shelves, and a TV.
Pro shop display wall of bowling balls under 'New Arrivals' signage with a row of bowling bags below.
Exterior storefront of the building with the blue 'ALL STAR BOWL' sign and glass entrance doors at dusk.
Wide panoramic interior view of the pro shop showing the service counter, walls of bowling balls and bags, and the colorful patterned carpet.
